requirements.text: WHEN user presses Cmd+K on Mac or Ctrl+K on Windows/Linux, the system shall open the quick search modal.
WHEN the quick search modal opens, the system shall focus the search input field.
WHEN user presses Enter with a result selected, the system shall close the modal and open the selected ticket's detail view.
WHEN user presses Escape while the modal is open, the system shall close the modal without selecting a ticket.
WHEN user clicks outside the modal content area, the system shall close the modal without selecting a ticket.
IF no tickets match the search query, the system shall display a 'No results' message in the results area.
The keyboard shortcut shall be Cmd+K on macOS and Ctrl+K on Windows/Linux platforms.
Title substring matching shall be case-insensitive.
WHEN user types in the search input, the system shall filter current-project tickets in real-time by key, title and stored external references using case-insensitive AND matching.

WHEN user presses up or down arrow keys in the search input, the system shall move selection between visible results and keep the selected result visible within the results scroller without moving input focus.

WHEN Quick Search opens with a current project, the system shall default numbers and text to that project and expose an All projects toggle that broadens both numeric and text discovery without changing the query or entity filter.

WHEN the query supplies a full ticket key or explicit @CODE scope, the system shall honor that explicit cross-project lookup independently of the All projects toggle while preserving external-identity matching for full keys.

WHEN results display matching query text, the system shall highlight matching substrings in ticket keys, titles, project labels and external-reference labels without changing text, accessible identities or link destinations.
Current-project filtering shall display at most 10 matching tickets; remote search shall retain the existing limit of 5 per project and 15 total.
Multi-word queries shall use AND logic across searchable ticket keys, titles and stored references in either project location.

WHEN Quick Search is open, the system shall keep concise keyboard guidance below the results, preserve native Tab navigation within the dialog, expose optional action-focus help and restore focus to its connected opener on close.

scenarios.title: Open quick search modal with keyboard shortcut
scenarios.given: I am on the board view with multiple tickets visible
scenarios.then: the quick search modal opens and the search input is focused

scenarios.title: Close modal with Escape key
scenarios.given: the quick search modal is open
scenarios.then: the modal closes without selecting a ticket

scenarios.title: Close modal by clicking outside
scenarios.given: the quick search modal is open
scenarios.when: I click outside the modal content area
scenarios.then: the modal closes without selecting a ticket

scenarios.title: Filter tickets by key number
scenarios.given: the quick search modal is open with multiple tickets available
scenarios.when: I type a ticket key number like "136"
scenarios.then: the results show only tickets with matching key numbers (e.g., MDT-136)

scenarios.title: Filter tickets by title substring
scenarios.given: the quick search modal is open with tickets titled "Badge Color Fix" and "Header Badge"
scenarios.then: the results show only "Badge Color Fix" (AND logic, case-insensitive)

scenarios.title: Display no results message
scenarios.given: the quick search modal is open
scenarios.when: I type a query that matches no ticket titles or keys
scenarios.then: the results area displays a "No results" message

scenarios.title: Navigate results with arrow keys
scenarios.given: the quick search modal shows multiple results
scenarios.when: I press the down arrow key then the up arrow key
scenarios.then: the selection moves to the next result then back to the previous result

scenarios.title: Select ticket and open detail view
scenarios.given: the quick search modal shows results with one selected
scenarios.then: the modal closes and the selected ticket detail view opens

scenarios.title: Numbers and text stay local unless all projects is enabled
scenarios.given: Current and other projects have matching numeric identities and title words
scenarios.when: Search by number and text, then enable All projects
scenarios.then: Local-only results become deduplicated cross-project results using every query term; query is preserved and new opens reset to local

scenarios.title: Explicit key and project scope override location
scenarios.given: All projects is off and another project contains a ticket
scenarios.when: Enter its full ticket key or @CODE query
scenarios.then: The explicit lookup finds the target while preserving external identities and @CODE scope

scenarios.title: Matching visible text is highlighted
scenarios.given: Results include keys, titles, project context and short external labels
scenarios.when: Search with numeric, text and literal punctuation queries
scenarios.then: Only matching visible substrings are marked without changing text, identities, glyphs, destinations or row selection

scenarios.title: Arrow navigation scrolls only the results
scenarios.given: The result list overflows a short viewport
scenarios.then: Selected rows stay visible inside the results and input retains focus

scenarios.title: Bottom help and bounded native keyboard traversal
scenarios.given: Quick Search is open from a focused control with result links
scenarios.when: Use native Tab at both boundaries, open optional help, use F6/Shift+F6 and close
scenarios.then: Focus wraps inside the dialog, reference popovers remain usable, help is below results, optional focus shortcuts preserve query and close restores the connected opener

obligations.title: Keyboard shortcut opens modal with auto-focused input
obligations.sourceRef: CR Section 4: Technical Details - Keyboard Handler

obligations.title: Escape key and click-outside close modal without selection
obligations.sourceRef: CR Section 4: User Flow #7, MODALS.md Required Behaviors

obligations.title: Arrow keys navigate through result items
Enter selects ticket and opens detail view
Display 'No results' message when no matches
Separate location from entity filter for key and text
Render safe literal matches through existing text owners
Limit current-project tickets to 10 and remote tickets to 5 per project and 15 total
Filter ticket keys, titles and refs using case-insensitive AND terms
Keep selection visible, bound native Tab, restore opener and explain shortcuts below results

testPlans.title: Query routing and safe literal highlight rendering
All-project multiword search preserves identity ordering
Quick Search project location, highlights, scrolling, focus boundaries and footer
